\subsection*{Published models M1--M4 (the Beta model uses \texttt{\_beta} versions of the same programs on the $\beta$ dimension only)}
\noindent\texttt{intentions\_game/memo\_models.py}

\begin{lstlisting}
@memo
def own_choice[t: Trial36, c: Option](belief: ..., pay: ...):
    """Phases 1 and 3: the participant, uncertain about their own preferences, allocates points."""
    participant: knows(t)
    participant: given(ia in AI, ib in BI, wpp=at2(ia, ib, belief))
    participant: chooses(c in Option, wpp=exp(utility(c, ia, ib, t, pay)))
    return Pr[participant.c == c]

@memo
def partner_choice[t: Trial54, ia: AI, ib: BI, c: Option](pay: ...):
    """How a partner with preferences (alpha[ia], beta[ib]) allocates points on trial t."""
    partner: knows(t, ia, ib)
    partner: chooses(c in Option, wpp=exp(utility(c, ia, ib, t, pay)))
    return Pr[partner.c == c]

@memo
def predict_partner[t: Trial54, g: Option](prior: ..., history: ..., pay: ...):
    """Phase 2: having watched the partner's earlier choices, the participant guesses the next one."""
    participant: knows(t)
    participant: thinks[
        partner: knows(t),
        partner: given(ia in AI, ib in BI, wpp=at2(ia, ib, prior)),
        partner: chooses(c in Option, wpp=exp(utility(c, ia, ib, t, pay))),
    ]
    participant: observes_event(wpp=at3(t, partner.ia, partner.ib, history))
    participant: guesses(g in Option, wpp=Pr[partner.c == g])
    return Pr[participant.g == g]
\end{lstlisting}

\subsection*{Model H: specification with an explicit population}
\noindent\texttt{intentions\_game/hier\_spec.py}

\begin{lstlisting}
@memo
def partner_likelihood[t: Trial54, k: Pref, c: Option](pay: ...):
    """How a partner with profile k allocates points on trial t."""
    partner: knows(t, k)
    partner: chooses(c in Option, wpp=exp(utility(c, k, t, pay)))
    return Pr[partner.c == c]

@memo
def predict_partner[t: Trial54, guess: Option](a, b, v_a, v_b, tau_a, tau_b, history: ..., pay: ...):
    """Phase 2: believing that they and the partner are two draws from one population of social
    preferences, the participant uses what they know about themselves, and what the partner has
    done so far, to guess the partner's next allocation."""
    participant: knows(t)
    participant: thinks[
        population: given(norm_k in Pref, uniformly),
        population: given(mine in Pref, wpp=resembles(mine, norm_k, tau_a, tau_b)),
        population: given(theirs in Pref, wpp=resembles(theirs, norm_k, tau_a, tau_b)),
        partner: knows(t, population.theirs),
        partner: chooses(c in Option, wpp=exp(utility(c, population.theirs, t, pay))),
    ]
    participant: observes_event(wpp=introspection(population.mine, a, b, v_a, v_b))
    participant: observes_event(wpp=at_trial(t, population.theirs, history))
    participant: guesses(guess in Option, wpp=Pr[partner.c == guess])
    return Pr[participant.guess == guess]

@memo
def own_choice[t: Trial36, c: Option](a, b, v_a, v_b, tau_a, tau_b, evidence: ..., pay: ...):
    """Phases 1 and 3: the participant allocates points as their self-model would, where the
    self-model is informed by introspection and, through the shared population, by everything
    the partner did (evidence = 1 everywhere before the partner is met)."""
    participant: knows(t)
    participant: thinks[
        population: given(norm_k in Pref, uniformly),
        population: given(mine in Pref, wpp=resembles(mine, norm_k, tau_a, tau_b)),
        population: given(theirs in Pref, wpp=resembles(theirs, norm_k, tau_a, tau_b)),
        myself: knows(t, population.mine),
        myself: chooses(c in Option, wpp=exp(utility(c, population.mine, t, pay))),
    ]
    participant: observes_event(wpp=introspection(population.mine, a, b, v_a, v_b))
    participant: observes_event(wpp=at(population.theirs, evidence))
    participant: chooses(c in Option, wpp=Pr[myself.c == c])
    return Pr[participant.c == c]
\end{lstlisting}

\subsection*{Model I: the partner's intent, and the attributions it implies}
\noindent\texttt{intentions\_game/intent.py}

\begin{lstlisting}
@memo
def intent_choice[t: Trial54, w: WI, r: RI, c: Option](pay: ...):
    """How a partner who weighs their own points by omega[w] and the participant's by rho[r] allocates."""
    partner: knows(t, w, r)
    partner: wants(earn=their_points(c, t, pay))
    partner: wants(sway=my_points(c, t, pay))
    partner: chooses(c in Option, wpp=exp(omega(w) * EU[earn] + rho(r) * EU[sway]))
    return Pr[partner.c == c]

@memo
def predict_intent[t: Trial54, guess: Option](prior: ..., history: ..., pay: ...):
    """Phase 2: the participant guesses the partner's next allocation by inferring the partner's
    motives (self-interest and benevolence or harm) from what the partner has done so far."""
    participant: knows(t)
    participant: thinks[
        partner: knows(t),
        partner: given(w in WI, r in RI, wpp=at2(w, r, prior)),
        partner: wants(earn=their_points(c, t, pay)),
        partner: wants(sway=my_points(c, t, pay)),
        partner: chooses(c in Option, wpp=exp(omega(w) * EU[earn] + rho(r) * EU[sway])),
    ]
    participant: observes_event(wpp=at3(t, partner.w, partner.r, history))
    participant: guesses(guess in Option, wpp=Pr[partner.c == guess])
    return Pr[participant.guess == guess]

@memo
def attribute_intent(prior: ..., evidence: ...):
    """After phase 2: how strongly the participant attributes harmful intent (wanting to reduce my
    points) and self-interest (wanting to earn points) to the partner."""
    participant: thinks[
        partner: given(w in WI, r in RI, wpp=at2(w, r, prior)),
    ]
    participant: observes_event(wpp=at2(partner.w, partner.r, evidence))
    return participant[E[harm(partner.r)]]
    return participant[E[omega(partner.w)]]
    return participant[Pr[rho(partner.r) < 0]]

@memo
def own_choice_intent[t: Trial36, c: Option](belief: ..., pay: ...):
    """Phases 1 and 3 of model C: the participant allocates points as their self-model would, an
    agent with the same two goals as the partner, whose motives (omega, rho) are uncertain."""
    participant: knows(t)
    participant: thinks[
        myself: knows(t),
        myself: given(w in WI, r in RI, wpp=at2(w, r, belief)),
        myself: wants(earn=to_decider(c, t, pay)),
        myself: wants(sway=to_recipient(c, t, pay)),
        myself: chooses(c in Option, wpp=exp(omega(w) * EU[earn] + rho(r) * EU[sway])),
    ]
    participant: chooses(c in Option, wpp=Pr[myself.c == c])
    return Pr[participant.c == c]
\end{lstlisting}

@memo
def own_choice[t: Trial36, c: Option](a, b, v_a, v_b, tau_w, tau_r, evidence: ..., pay: ...):
    """Phases 1 and 3: the participant allocates points as their self-model would, an agent with the
    same two goals, whose motives are informed by introspection and, through the shared population,
    by everything the partner did (evidence = 1 everywhere before the partner is met)."""
    participant: knows(t)
    participant: thinks[
        population: given(norm_k in Motive, uniformly),
        population: given(mine in Motive, wpp=resembles(mine, norm_k, tau_w, tau_r)),
        population: given(theirs in Motive, wpp=resembles(theirs, norm_k, tau_w, tau_r)),
        myself: knows(t, population.mine),
        myself: wants(earn=to_decider(c, t, pay)),
        myself: wants(sway=to_recipient(c, t, pay)),
        myself: chooses(c in Option, wpp=exp(omega(population.mine) * EU[earn]
                                             + rho(population.mine) * EU[sway])),
    ]
    participant: observes_event(wpp=introspection(population.mine, a, b, v_a, v_b))
    participant: observes_event(wpp=at(population.theirs, evidence))
    participant: chooses(c in Option, wpp=Pr[myself.c == c])
    return Pr[participant.c == c]

@memo
def partner_likelihood[t: Trial54, k: Motive, c: Option](pay: ...):
    """How a partner with motives k allocates points on trial t."""
    partner: knows(t, k)
    partner: wants(earn=to_decider(c, t, pay))
    partner: wants(sway=to_recipient(c, t, pay))
    partner: chooses(c in Option, wpp=exp(omega(k) * EU[earn] + rho(k) * EU[sway]))
    return Pr[partner.c == c]

\subsection*{Advisor model: belief update after the outcome (\texttt{choose\_pumps} is shown in Box 1 of the article)}
\noindent\texttt{advice\_taking/bart\_et\_advisor.py}

\begin{lstlisting}
@memo
def update_reliability[a: Level, p: Level, o: Outcome, r: RelIdx](rel_belief: ..., thr_prior: ..., lam):
    """Participant's posterior over advisor reliability after advice a, own pumps p, and outcome o."""
    participant: knows(p, o, r)
    participant: thinks[
        advisor: given(r in RelIdx, wpp=pmf(r, rel_belief)),
        advisor: given(intent in Intent, wpp=p_intent(intent, r)),
        world: given(t in Level, wpp=pmf(t, thr_prior)),
        advisor: knows(world.t),
        advisor: chooses(adv in Level, wpp=advice_lik(adv, world.t, intent, lam)),
    ]
    participant: observes [advisor.adv] is a
    participant: observes_that [(world.t <= p) == (o == {Outcome.POP})]
    return participant[Pr[advisor.r == r]]
\end{lstlisting}

\subsection*{Developmental case: asking, endorsing and learning}
\noindent\texttt{development/corriveau\_trust.py}

\begin{lstlisting}
@memo
def ask[whom: Informant](kinds: ..., beta_ask):
    """Before anyone speaks: whom does the child want to ask, given who has seemed helpful so far?"""
    child: thinks[
        world: given(mother_kind in Kind, stranger_kind in Kind, wpp=at2(mother_kind, stranger_kind, kinds)),
    ]
    child: chooses(whom in Informant, wpp=exp(beta_ask * (
        Pr[world.mother_kind == {Kind.HELPFUL}] if whom == {Informant.MOTHER}
        else Pr[world.stranger_kind == {Kind.HELPFUL}])))
    return Pr[child.whom == whom]

@memo
def endorse[choice: Name](kinds: ..., p_strangers, beta, agreeableness):
    """After hearing conflicting names and seeing the picture: which name does the child accept?"""
    child: thinks[
        world: given(mother_kind in Kind, stranger_kind in Kind, wpp=at2(mother_kind, stranger_kind, kinds)),
        world: given(name in Name, wpp=looks_like(name, p_strangers)),
        mother: knows(world.name, world.mother_kind),
        mother: chooses(claim in Name, wpp=says(claim, world.name, world.mother_kind)),
        stranger: knows(world.name, world.stranger_kind),
        stranger: chooses(claim in Name, wpp=says(claim, world.name, world.stranger_kind)),
    ]
    child: observes_that[mother.claim == {Name.MOTHERS}]
    child: observes_that[stranger.claim == {Name.STRANGERS}]
    child: wants(correct=choice == world.name)
    child: wants(agree=choice == {Name.MOTHERS})
    child: chooses(choice in Name, wpp=exp(beta * (EU[correct] + agreeableness * EU[agree])))
    return Pr[child.choice == choice]

@memo
def update[mk: Kind, sk: Kind](kinds: ..., p_strangers):
    """After the trial: what the child now believes about who is helpful."""
    child: knows(mk, sk)
    child: thinks[
        world: given(mother_kind in Kind, stranger_kind in Kind, wpp=at2(mother_kind, stranger_kind, kinds)),
        world: given(name in Name, wpp=looks_like(name, p_strangers)),
        mother: knows(world.name, world.mother_kind),
        mother: chooses(claim in Name, wpp=says(claim, world.name, world.mother_kind)),
        stranger: knows(world.name, world.stranger_kind),
        stranger: chooses(claim in Name, wpp=says(claim, world.name, world.stranger_kind)),
    ]
    child: observes_that[mother.claim == {Name.MOTHERS}]
    child: observes_that[stranger.claim == {Name.STRANGERS}]
    return child[Pr[world.mother_kind == mk, world.stranger_kind == sk]]
\end{lstlisting}

\subsection*{Developmental case: the child's private belief}
\noindent\texttt{development/corriveau\_routes.py}

\begin{lstlisting}
@memo
def believes[n: Name](kinds: ..., p_strangers):
    """After hearing conflicting names and seeing the picture: how likely the child thinks each name is."""
    child: knows(n)
    child: thinks[
        world: given(mother_kind in Kind, stranger_kind in Kind, wpp=at2(mother_kind, stranger_kind, kinds)),
        world: given(name in Name, wpp=looks_like(name, p_strangers)),
        mother: knows(world.name, world.mother_kind),
        mother: chooses(claim in Name, wpp=says(claim, world.name, world.mother_kind)),
        stranger: knows(world.name, world.stranger_kind),
        stranger: chooses(claim in Name, wpp=says(claim, world.name, world.stranger_kind)),
    ]
    child: observes_that[mother.claim == {Name.MOTHERS}]
    child: observes_that[stranger.claim == {Name.STRANGERS}]
    return child[Pr[world.name == n]]
\end{lstlisting}
